t2.title: Professional athletes be paid so much money
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should professional athletes be paid so much money?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Professional athletes earn millions while teachers and nurses earn modest salaries. While this seems unfair, I believe the market determines their worth.

Firstly, athlete salaries reflect what people are willing to pay for entertainment. Millions watch sports events, buy merchandise, and subscribe to sports channels. Athletes' earnings come from this revenue, not taxpayer money.

Secondly, athletic careers are extremely short. Most athletes retire in their thirties, and many suffer long-term injuries. High earnings compensate for these risks and short career spans.

However, the contrast with essential workers' pay is troubling. While athletes are paid by private companies, it raises questions about society's priorities when nurses struggle financially.

Furthermore, excessive wealth can negatively influence young people, creating unrealistic expectations. More athletes should use their platform and wealth for charitable causes.

In conclusion, while athlete salaries are determined by market forces, society should also ensure fair compensation for essential professions. Athletes earning millions is acceptable if they contribute positively to society.

I like the sports club. It is good. I play tennis and football. The club is big. I like the coaches because they are nice.

Athletes have lots of money and it is good for them. They play well. But teachers are good too, and they don't have lots of money. I think it is not fair. Maybe athletes get too much money. But I like to watch them play.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear Student Magazine,

I am writing about athletes and their salaries. I think it's a complicated issue. On one hand, professional athletes earn a lot of money, and it seems unfair when you compare them to nurses or teachers who do important jobs.

However, athletes train very hard and they are very talented. Also, many people enjoy watching them play, so the clubs make a lot of money. The athletes get paid from this money. For example, a famous football player can bring millions to a club.

In my opinion, it's up to the clubs to decide how much to pay their athletes. But I also think that athletes should remember that they are lucky and should use their money to help others.

Sincerely,
A Sports Club Member
t2.sampleB2: Are Athletes Worth Their Millions? Every time a footballer signs a jaw-dropping contract, the same argument breaks out: how can someone earn more for kicking a ball than a surgeon earns for saving lives? It is a fair question, but the answer is not as simple as it looks. On the one hand, sport is big business. Millions of fans buy tickets, subscribe to channels and snap up merchandise, and it is the star players who pull in that money. In a way, athletes are simply getting their fair share of the fortune they help create. After all, a superstar like Messi brings in far more for his club than he is ever paid. On top of that, sporting careers are short and brutal. One serious injury can end everything overnight, so it makes sense to cash in while they can. On the other hand, the gap between athletes and everyday heroes like nurses and teachers is hard to swallow. It says a lot about what our society chooses to value. All things considered, I do not think athletes are overpaid — the market decides that. Still, with great wealth should come a little more responsibility.
t2.uzSample:
Professional sportchilar millionlab pul topishadi, o'qituvchilar va hamshiralar esa kamtarona maosh olishadi. Bu adolatsizlikdek tuyulsa-da, men bozorda ularning qiymati belgilanadi deb hisoblayman.

Birinchidan, sportchilarning maoshlari odamlarning ko'ngilochar tomoshalar uchun to'lashga tayyor ekanligini aks ettiradi. Millionlab odamlar sport tadbirlarini tomosha qilishadi, mahsulotlar sotib olishadi va sport kanallariga obuna bo'lishadi. Sportchilarning daromadi soliq to'lovchilarning pulidan emas, balki shu daromaddan keladi.

Ikkinchidan, sportchilik faoliyati juda qisqa. Ko'pgina sportchilar o'ttiz yoshlarida nafaqaga chiqishadi va ko'pchilik uzoq muddatli jarohatlardan aziyat chekishadi. Yuqori daromadlar ushbu xavflar va qisqa faoliyat muddatini qoplaydi.

Biroq, muhim ishchilarning maoshi bilan bo'lgan farq tashvishga soladi. Sportchilarga xususiy kompaniyalar tomonidan pul to'lansa-da, hamshiralar moliyaviy qiyinchiliklarga duch kelganda, bu jamiyatning ustuvorliklari haqida savollar tug'diradi.

Bundan tashqari, haddan tashqari boylik yoshlarga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi, norealistik umidlar yaratishi mumkin. Ko'proq sportchilar o'zlarining platformasi va boyligidan xayriya maqsadlarida foydalanishlari kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, sportchilarning maoshlari bozor kuchlari bilan belgilanar ekan, jamiyat ham muhim kasblar uchun adolatli to'lovni ta'minlashi kerak. Agar sportchilar millionlab pul topib, jamiyatga ijobiy hissa qo'shsa, bu maqbuldir.

Salom!

Menga sport klubi yoqadi. U qiziqarli. Men futbol o'ynayman. Bu yaxshi. Sportchilar yaxshi. Ular tez yuguradi. Ularda pul bor. Menga pul yoqadi. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,

Men sport klubini yaxshi ko'raman. U yaxshi. Men tennis va futbol o'ynayman. Klub katta. Menga murabbiylar yoqadi, chunki ular yaxshi.

Sportchilarning puli ko'p va bu ular uchun yaxshi. Ular yaxshi o'ynashadi. Lekin o'qituvchilar ham yaxshi, lekin ularning puli ko'p emas. Menimcha, bu adolatdan emas. Balki sportchilar juda ko'p pul olishar. Lekin men ularning o'yinini tomosha qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.

Xayr.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Talabalar Jurnali,

Men sportchilar va ularning maoshlari haqida yozmoqdaman. Menimcha, bu murakkab masala. Bir tomondan, professional sportchilar juda ko'p pul topishadi va bu, muhim ishlarni qiladigan hamshiralar yoki o'qituvchilar bilan solishtirganda adolatsizlikdek tuyuladi.

Biroq, sportchilar juda qattiq mashq qilishadi va ular juda iste'dodli. Shuningdek, ko'p odamlar ularning o'yinini tomosha qilishdan zavqlanishadi, shuning uchun klublar juda ko'p pul topishadi. Sportchilar shu puldan maosh olishadi. Misol uchun, mashhur futbolchi klubga millionlab pul olib kelishi mumkin.

Mening fikrimcha, sportchilarga qancha pul to'lashni klublar hal qilishi kerak. Lekin men, shuningdek, sportchilar omadli ekanliklarini eslashlari va pullarini boshqalarga yordam berish uchun ishlatishlari kerak deb o'ylayman.

Hurmat bilan,
Sport Klubining A'zosi
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Talabalar Jurnali,

Professional sportchilarning haddan tashqari yuqori maoshlari atrofidagi bahs-munozaralar murakkab bo'lib, bozor kuchlarini ijtimoiy qadriyatlarga qarshi qo'yadi. Garchi bu summalar ko'pincha nomutanosibdek tuyulsa-da, ayniqsa muhim ishchilarning daromadlari bilan solishtirganda, nozik nuqtai nazar talab etiladi.

Birinchidan, professional sportning katta daromad keltirishi inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Televideniye huquqlari, tovarlar sotuvi va chiptalar sotuvi klublar g'aznasiga katta hissa qo'shadi va sportchilar bu iqtisodiy dvigatelning markaziy qismidir. Ularning ajoyib mahorati va fidoyiligi tomoshabinlarni jalb qiladi, bu esa ma'lum darajada ularning yuqori haqini oqlaydi. Misol uchun, futbolning global jozibasini ko'rib chiqing, unda yulduz futbolchilar o'zlarining bozordagi qiymati va o'yinlari asosida astronomik maosh oladilar.

Ikkinchidan, sportchilarning faoliyati juda qisqa va jismoniy jihatdan talabchan bo'ladi. Doimiy ravishda o'zini ko'rsatish bosimi, jarohat olish xavfi bilan birga, sportchilarning daromad olish imkoniyatlarini maksimal darajada oshirish uchun cheklangan vaqti bor deganidir. Bu omillar yuqori tovon pulini talab qilishi mumkin.

Biroq, sportchilarning maoshlari va hamshiralik va o'qituvchilik kabi muhim kasblarning maoshlari o'rtasidagi keskin tafovut axloqiy jihatdan muammoli bo'lib qolmoqda. Bu jamiyatning ustuvorliklari va resurslarni taqsimlash haqida savollar tug'diradi. Bundan tashqari, sportda boylikni ulug'lash yoshlar orasida noreal umidlarni yaratishi mumkin. Shuning uchun sportchilarning o'z platformalaridan ijobiy ijtimoiy ta'sir uchun foydalanishiga katta e'tibor berish muhimdir.

Hurmat bilan,
Xavotirli Sport Ishqibozi

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the sports club management. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear ActiveLife Management, Thank you for asking about my experience at your sports club. I have been thoroughly enjoying my membership. The facilities are exceptionally well-maintained, and the variety of sports available is impressive. The coaching sessions have significantly improved my tennis skills, and the coaches are incredibly supportive. However, I have noticed some areas for improvement. The changing rooms can become quite crowded during peak hours. I would suggest extending opening hours or adding more facilities. Additionally, I would love to see yoga classes and martial arts programs introduced. A social events calendar for members to meet and play together would also build community spirit. Overall, joining ActiveLife was a great decision and I will certainly renew my membership. Yours sincerely, Akmal Tojiyev
t12.sampleA1:
Hi ActiveLife,


I like the club. It is good. I play football. I like football. The gym is big. I go swimming. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hi ActiveLife,


Thank you for the letter. I like the sports club. It is fun. I play tennis and I go to the gym. The gym is good. But sometimes it is busy. I want to try basketball, but you don't have it. Maybe you can have basketball? Thank you. Bye.
t12.sampleB1:
Dear ActiveLife Management,


Thank you for your letter. I am enjoying being a member of the sports club. The facilities are good, especially the swimming pool. I also like the tennis courts. The coaching sessions are helpful, but I think they could be longer.


I think you should add more classes. For example, I would like to see a yoga class. Also, maybe you could have more activities for children. This would be good for families.


Overall, I am happy with the sports club. I hope you consider my suggestions.


Sincerely,
Akmal Tojiyev
t12.sampleB2: Dear ActiveLife Management, Thank you for your warm welcome and for asking about my first few weeks as a member. On the whole, I have been thoroughly impressed. The facilities are spotless, the range of sports on offer is excellent, and the tennis coaching sessions have already done wonders for my technique. The coaches genuinely go out of their way to help. That said, there is room for improvement. The changing rooms tend to get overcrowded during peak hours, so extending opening times would make a real difference. I would also be delighted if you could bring in yoga classes and set up a regular social calendar, as this would help members get to know one another. All in all, joining was a great decision, and I look forward to many more months here. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova

Hurmat bilan,
Akmal Tojiyev
